notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone, thanks for the support on Astronook's demo, got a small update here.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Addition[/b] - Improved Controller / Steamdeck Support (see all gamepad fixes + changes below)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Small Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now click on star icons to jump to that relevant constellation straight away[/p][/*][*][p]Added Invert X/Y settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added basic performance quality settings to disable Ambient Occlusion, Shadows + VSync (disabling Shadows will help most for performance, not the intended game look though)[/p][/*][*][p]If you hover over tutorial instruction in telescope view it fades out so you can see behind the instruction[/p][/*][*][p]Made it so you can uncomplete tutorial instructions eg. if start focusing with F then stop focusing with F again, instruction will now uncheck for clearer feedback (wasn’t very intuitive without this before)[/p][/*][*][p]Added extra tutorial prompt informing you that you have to click on the planet again to zoom back out (after completed main tutorial)[/p][/*][*][p]Added small enter/exit animations to tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered dialogue panel a little for 16:10 aspect ratio[/p][/*][*][p]Made star map smaller for 16:10 so it doesn’t get in the way of telescope view[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed soft-lock of not being able to exit telescope if got News alert for the first time while in telescope and then completed constellation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed irregular audio scaling with sound/music volume sliders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed music abrupt volume change when restart game after changing music slider value[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sometimes Star Chart images staying selected after closing Star Chart[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed menu buttons sometimes staying in the wrong states[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floating photo when pickup another photo while already holding one[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed soft-lock where you got stuck in the tutorial if you picked up the photo before relevant task and stuck the photo in[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Gamepad Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed gamepad cursor jerking upon scene loads (was causing most issues on Steamdeck)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed trackpad not working on Steamdeck, you can now use the trackpad to map out constellations if you want to[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed left/right triggers not working on computer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed left/right triggers causing cursor jerk[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed computer mouse starting off “stuck” just off-screen sometimes when using gamepad[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Gamepad Scroll Speed setting not working[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Gamepad Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now use left stick to map out constellations too if you want to[/p][/*][*][p]You can now exit telescope, star chart, etc with East Button (B/Circle) instead of being same as interact button (X/Square)[/p][/*][*][p]Made East Button (B/Circle) work to go back in settings menu or exit pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Can now exit telescope while in camera mode with gamepad[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also I definitely want to change the star mapping sound effects since a few of you said that they don't fit the tone of the game and I agree, so hoping to sort that out next.[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any other feedback you can submit it here [url="https://forms.gle/cjCuTxBNenNC2w5DA"]https://forms.gle/cjCuTxBNenNC2w5DA[/url] or on the Steam discussions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you 💙[/p]
